subject: Private deployment BYOK: air-gapped certification & handover plan
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmehealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment BYOK — air-gapped checklist and certification asks

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we scope the private deployment for our on-prem clinical environment, the security team has a few specific asks we need to fold into the DPA and implementation plan: 

- Confirmation that customer-controlled keys (BYOK) are enforceable in air-gapped deployments (no outbound key material).
- Operator access model: we need an explicit list of RBAC roles and the breakglass process for emergency forensic access.
- Evidence for certification: can you provide a checklist or sample artifacts (audit log samples, operator access records) that we can use for our internal audit?
- Cross-border/non-production telemetry: we require assurances and a mechanism to opt-out of any telemetry that leaves our VPC.

I attached the initial requirements document from our security & procurement teams (Attachment: acme_byo_requirements.pdf). Can you confirm what you can provide as part of the standard Private deployment vs. what will be handled as a custom addendum?

Goal: have a concrete handover & audit plan for signature by 2025-07-10 so internal engineering can schedule the deployment window.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Senior Security Program Manager — Acme Health
[Attachment: acme_byo_requirements.pdf (PDF)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment BYOK — air-gapped checklist and certification asks

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. High level responses below; I added Kim, Lauren and Priyom to scope the DPA addendum and the ops runbook.

1) BYOK in air-gapped: supported. For on-prem air-gapped installs we offer a customer-controlled keystore that never leaves the customer network. Our standard Private deployment template includes a keystore connector that is configured for local HSM/KMS or an on-site Vault. We'll provide the keystore integration spec and the recommended verification steps.

2) Operator access: our default posture is zero-operator access to live customer model inputs. For the on-prem package we provide a documented set of operator roles (maintenance, monitoring, emergency) and a breakglass flow that requires multi-party approval and time-limited credentials. We can provide an operator access matrix.

3) Certification evidence: we can share sanitized audit log samples, a redacted operator access ledger, and a sample SOC-style evidence pack that aligns with the DPA. Those items are part of the Private deployment deliverable but some items may require an addendum if you need full raw logs.

4) Telemetry opt-out: we have a telemetry toggle for private installs that disables any outgoing usage or debug telemetry by default; we can also ship a signed configuration that enforces opt-out.

Attached: proposed handover spreadsheet (redwood_proposed_handover.xlsx) and a DPA excerpt template (dpa-excerpt-acme-redwood.docx).

Next steps: Kim and Priyom — can you confirm which artifacts we can attach to the standard delivery vs. which will require legal/contracting redlines?

Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_proposed_handover.xlsx (XLSX)]
[Attachment: dpa-excerpt-acme-redwood.docx (DOCX)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 29 Jun 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment BYOK — air-gapped checklist and certification asks

Jonas — quick internal note before we reply back to Sarah with a single consolidated package. I reviewed the attachments; proposed split: 

- Standard deliverable (no legal change): integration spec, keystore connector docs, telemetry opt-out guide, sanitized sample logs (redacted).
- Requires addendum / negotiation: raw operator ledgers, full-length unredacted logs, any escrow/escrow-keystore clauses, and a commitment to specific on-site personnel access windows.

Action items:
- Priyom: please draft a concise operator access matrix (roles, privileges, breakglass steps) plus a short blurb on how we rotate emergency keys.
- Lauren: compile the sample evidence pack and confirm which items we can safely sanitize for distribution.
- Jonas: I can draft the commercial language for the addendum (what we include vs what is billable as professional services).

I want to keep the customer feeling supported here — propose we offer a 2-hour technical handoff call + audit artifact bundle as part of the Private package, and then make raw forensic artifacts an on-demand PS engagement.

Kimberly Park
Director, Trust & Compliance — Redwood Inference

From: Legal (Acme Health) <legal@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Private deployment BYOK — air-gapped checklist and certification asks

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached are redlines to the DPA excerpt you shared and a short list of clarifying questions. The key points from our side: 

- We need explicit contractual language that operational staff (Redwood employees) will not have routine access to customer plaintext data or key material; any emergency access must be logged, time-limited, and require prior approval from Acme's Security Officer.
- For air-gapped installs, Acme requires a clause stating that key escrow is not permitted except under a court order; Redwood should document the process for responding to lawful requests.
- Please confirm the scope and retention period for sanitized logs we will receive as part of the standard deliverable.

We are generally aligned with your split between standard deliverables and PS-delivered forensic artifacts. Please review our redlines (Attachment: dpa-acme-redlines.docx) and propose final language. Also include a short paragraph that our auditors can use to map the artifacts to their checklist.

Regards,
M. Santos
Senior Counsel — Acme Health
[Attachment: dpa-acme-redlines.docx (DOCX)]
